const formatRelative = (value: Date | null) => {
  if (!value) return "never"
  const diffMs = Date.now() - value.getTime()
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000)
  if (diffMin < 1) return "just now"
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}m ago`
  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60)
  if (diffHr < 24) return `${diffHr}h ago`
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24)
  return `${diffDay}d ago`
}

        .replaceAll("_", " ")

import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm"

import { isAdminEmailAllowlisted } from "@/lib/admin-access"
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { user } from "@/lib/db/schema"

export type AdminManagedUser = {
  id: string
  name: string | null
  email: string
  emailVerified: boolean
  isAdmin: boolean
  isAdminPersisted: boolean
  isAdminManagedByAllowlist: boolean
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

type UserRow = {
  id: string
  name: string | null
  email: string
  emailVerified: boolean
  isAdmin: boolean
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
}

const toAdminManagedUser = (row: UserRow): AdminManagedUser => {
  const isAdminManagedByAllowlist = isAdminEmailAllowlisted(row.email)

  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    email: row.email,
    emailVerified: row.emailVerified,
    isAdminPersisted: row.isAdmin,
    isAdminManagedByAllowlist,
    isAdmin: row.isAdmin || isAdminManagedByAllowlist,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  }
}

export const listAdminManagedUsers = async (): Promise<AdminManagedUser[]> => {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      email: user.email,
      emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      isAdmin: user.isAdmin,
      createdAt: user.createdAt,
      updatedAt: user.updatedAt,
    })
    .from(user)
    .orderBy(asc(user.email))

  return rows.map((row) => toAdminManagedUser(row as UserRow))
}

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"

import {
  BRANCH_LIFECYCLE_PENDING_PRUNE,
  buildBranchKey,
  deriveBranchRowState,
  type IndexBranch,
} from "./model"

const makeBranch = (overrides: Partial<IndexBranch> = {}): IndexBranch => ({
  id: "1234567890abcdef",
  branch: "main",
  configHash: "default-v1",
  lastReadySha: "abc",
  lastReadyRunId: null,
  servingUpdatedAt: null,
  lifecycleStatus: "active",
  pendingPruneAt: null,
  pendingPruneReason: null,
  updatedAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  lastRun: null,
  lastReadyRun: null,
  lastReadyGraphSnapshotStatus: null,
  reconcile: null,
  ...overrides,
})

describe("deriveBranchRowState", () => {
  test("derives pending prune, queued pending, and failed error details", () => {

const branch = makeBranch({
      lifecycleStatus: BRANCH_LIFECYCLE_PENDING_PRUNE,
      pendingPruneAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      pendingPruneReason: "branch_missing",
      reconcile: {
        jobId: "job-1",
        status: "enqueued",
        checkedAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        wasChecked: true,
        wasEnqueued: true,
        headSha: "def",
        lastReadySha: "abc",
        missing: true,
        pendingPruneAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        pruned: false,
        errorCode: "branch_missing",
      },
      lastRun: {
        id: "run-1",
        headSha: "def",
        mode: "full",
        status: "failed",
        error: "Missing embedding API key",
        updatedAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:01.000Z",
      },
    })

    const rowKey = buildBranchKey(branch.branch, branch.configHash)
    const result = deriveBranchRowState({
      branch,
      nowMs: Date.parse("2026-01-01T00:03:00.000Z"),
      recentlyQueuedRun: {
        key: rowKey,
        requestedAtMs: Date.parse("2026-01-01T00:03:00.000Z"),
        runId: null,
      },
    })

    expect(result.rowKey).toBe(rowKey)
    expect(result.isStale).toBe(true)
    expect(result.isPendingPrune).toBe(true)
    expect(result.pendingPruneIdentifier).toBe("cleanup:12345678")
    expect(result.pendingPruneReason).toBe("branch missing")
    expect(result.isQueuedPending).toBe(true)
    expect(result.isPipelineActive).toBe(true)
    expect(result.graphStatus).toBe("failed")
    expect(result.lastRunError?.hint).toContain("INDEXER_EMBEDDING_API_KEY")
  })

  )

  const { url, close } = await startEmbeddingServer(3)
  const configPath = path.join(repoDir, 'argus-search.json')
  fs.writeFileSync(
    configPath,
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        projectRoot: repoDir,
        inputs: { paths: ['src'], include: ['*.ts'], exclude: ['node_modules', 'dist', '.git'] },
        phases: { parse: true, graph: true, vector: true, scip: false, indexPack: false },
        vector: { provider: { kind: 'http', baseUrl: url, model: 'test-model', dimension: 3 } },
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
    'utf8',
  )

  try {
    const watch = await runCli(['watch', '--config', configPath, '--once'])
    t.is(watch.code, 0, watch.stderr)

    const search = await runCli(['search', 'Login', '--config', configPath, '--top-k', '3', '--context', '0'])
    t.is(search.code, 0, search.stderr)

    const searchColor = await runCli(['search', 'Login', '--config', configPath, '--top-k', '1', '--color', 'always'])

      'Login',
      '--config',
      configPath,
      '--top-k',
      '3',
      '--context',
      '0',
      '--include-content',
      '--json',
    ])
    t.is(searchJson.code, 0, searchJson.stderr)

const payload = JSON.parse(searchJson.stdout) as Array<{ content?: string | null }>

    // Output format includes "IMPACT" header with transitive callers info

    t.true(searchImpact.stdout.includes('main'))

      '--top-k',

      '--impact',

function formatStatus(c, status, name, message) {
  const f = fmt(c)
  let icon
  let statusColor

  switch (status) {
    case 'ok':
      icon = f.symbols.check
      statusColor = c.green
      break
    case 'warn':
      icon = f.symbols.warning
      statusColor = c.yellow
      break
    case 'error':
      icon = f.symbols.cross
      statusColor = c.red
      break
    default:
      icon = f.symbols.info
      statusColor = c.cyan
  }

  const statusText = String(status).toUpperCase().padEnd(5)
  const nameText = String(name).padEnd(14)
  return `${icon} ${statusColor}${statusText}${c.reset} ${c.bold}${nameText}${c.reset} ${c.dim}${message}${c.reset}`
}

/**
 * Format a progress/event message
 */
function formatEvent(c, event, message) {
  const f = fmt(c)
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 19)

  let icon
  let color
  switch (event) {
    case 'start':
    case 'index_start':
      icon = '▶'
      color = c.cyan
      break
    case 'complete':
    case 'index_complete':
      icon = f.symbols.check
      color = c.green
      break
    case 'error':
      icon = f.symbols.cross
      color = c.red
      break
    case 'stopping':
      icon = '◼'
      color = c.yellow
      break
    default:
      icon = f.symbols.info
      color = c.blue
  }

  return `${c.dim}[${timestamp}]${c.reset} ${color}${icon}${c.reset} ${message}`
}

fn map_symbol_kind(kind: Kind) -> &'static str {
  match kind {
    Kind::Class => "class",
    Kind::Method
    | Kind::AbstractMethod
    | Kind::StaticMethod
    | Kind::ProtocolMethod
    | Kind::PureVirtualMethod
    | Kind::TraitMethod
    | Kind::TypeClassMethod
    | Kind::MethodSpecification => "method",
    Kind::Function => "function",
    Kind::Variable
    | Kind::StaticVariable
    | Kind::Constant
    | Kind::Property
    | Kind::StaticProperty
    | Kind::Field
    | Kind::StaticField
    | Kind::StaticDataMember => "variable",
    Kind::Interface | Kind::Protocol | Kind::Trait | Kind::TypeClass => "interface",
    Kind::Enum => "enum",
    Kind::EnumMember => "enum_member",
    Kind::Namespace | Kind::Module | Kind::Package | Kind::PackageObject => "namespace",
    Kind::TypeAlias | Kind::Type => "type_alias",
    Kind::Parameter | Kind::SelfParameter | Kind::ThisParameter => "parameter",
    Kind::TypeParameter => "type_parameter",
    _ => "unknown",
  }
}

fn display_name(symbol_info: &SymbolInformation) -> Option<String> {
  if !symbol_info.display_name.is_empty() {
    return Some(symbol_info.display_name.clone());
  }
  None
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <version>"
  exit 1
fi

VERSION="$1"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"

update_package_json() {
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='$ROOT_DIR/package.json';const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));data.version='$VERSION';fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\\n');"
}

update_cargo_toml() {
  awk -v v="$VERSION" 'BEGIN{updated=0} /^version =/ && !updated { print "version = \"" v "\""; updated=1; next } { print }' \
    "$ROOT_DIR/Cargo.toml" > "$ROOT_DIR/Cargo.toml.tmp"
  mv "$ROOT_DIR/Cargo.toml.tmp" "$ROOT_DIR/Cargo.toml"
}

update_pyproject_toml() {
  awk -v v="$VERSION" 'BEGIN{updated=0} /^version =/ && !updated { print "version = \"" v "\""; updated=1; next } { print }' \
    "$ROOT_DIR/pyproject.toml" > "$ROOT_DIR/pyproject.toml.tmp"
  mv "$ROOT_DIR/pyproject.toml.tmp" "$ROOT_DIR/pyproject.toml"
}

update_changelog() {
  if ! grep -q "^## $VERSION" "$ROOT_DIR/CHANGELOG.md"; then
    echo "Missing CHANGELOG entry for $VERSION. Add it before release." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

update_index_js() {
  if [ -f "$ROOT_DIR/index.js" ]; then
    python - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
path = Path("$ROOT_DIR/index.js")
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace("1.0.0", "$VERSION").replace("0.1.0", "$VERSION")
path.write_text(text)
PY
  fi
}

update_package_json
update_cargo_toml
update_pyproject_toml
update_index_js
update_changelog

echo "Updated versions to $VERSION"
module.exports = { indexStream }

fn map_edge_type(edge_type: &str) -> String {
  match edge_type.to_lowercase().as_str() {
    "import" | "imports" => "IMPORTS".to_string(),
    "export" | "exports" => "EXPORTS".to_string(),
    "call" | "calls" => "CALLS".to_string(),
    "called_by" => "CALLED_BY".to_string(),
    "reference" | "references" => "REFERENCES".to_string(),
    "extends" | "inheritance" => "EXTENDS".to_string(),
    "implements" => "IMPLEMENTS".to_string(),
    "extends_interface" => "EXTENDS_INTERFACE".to_string(),
    "contains" => "CONTAINS".to_string(),
    "similar_to" | "semantic_similar" => "SIMILAR_TO".to_string(),
    "has_type" => "HAS_TYPE".to_string(),
    "decorated_by" => "DECORATED_BY".to_string(),
    "overrides" => "OVERRIDES".to_string(),
    // Keep unknown edge labels queryable instead of dropping them.
    _ => "REFERENCES".to_string(),
  }
}

fn chunk_to_graph_node(chunk: &CodeChunk, project_root: &Path) -> GraphNodeRecord {
  let normalized_file_path = normalize_file_path(&chunk.file_path, project_root);
  GraphNodeRecord {
    id: chunk.id.clone(),
    kind: chunk.kind.clone(),
    name: chunk.name.clone(),
    file_path: Some(normalized_file_path),
    range: Some(chunk.range),
    language: Some(chunk.language.clone()),
    sources: vec![GraphSource::TreeSitter],
    metadata: chunk.metadata.clone().map(|meta| json!(meta)),
    metadata_by_source: Some(HashMap::from([(
      "tree-sitter".to_string(),
      chunk

        .clone()
        .map(|meta| json!(meta))
        .unwrap_or(json!({})),
    )])),
  }
}

const mapMergeRequest = (
  row: Record<string, unknown>,
  currentUser: GitLabCurrentUser,
): MergeRequest => {
  const assignees = Array.isArray(row.assignees) ? row.assignees : []
  const reviewers = Array.isArray(row.reviewers) ? row.reviewers : []

  const authorRecord = asRecord(row.author)
  const authorName =
    typeof authorRecord?.name === "string" &&
    authorRecord.name.trim().length > 0
      ? authorRecord.name
      : "Unknown author"

  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    iid: String(row.iid),
    title: String(row.title ?? ""),
    state: String(row.state ?? "unknown"),
    author: authorName,
    webUrl: String(row.web_url ?? ""),
    projectId:
      typeof row.project_id === "number" || typeof row.project_id === "string"
        ? String(row.project_id)
        : undefined,
    sourceBranch:
      typeof row.source_branch === "string" ? row.source_branch : undefined,
    targetBranch:
      typeof row.target_branch === "string" ? row.target_branch : undefined,
    authoredByCurrentUser: isSameGitLabUser(row.author, currentUser),
    assignedToCurrentUser: assignees.some((assignee) =>
      isSameGitLabUser(assignee, currentUser),
    ),
    reviewRequestedFromCurrentUser: reviewers.some((reviewer) =>
      isSameGitLabUser(reviewer, currentUser),
    ),
  }
}

const countRows = await db
          .select({ totalRuns: sql<number>`count(*)` })
          .from(aiReviewFlowRuns)
          .where(flowWhere)
        const totalRuns = asInt(countRows[0]?.totalRuns)
        const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalRuns / limit))
        const page = Math.min(requestedPage, totalPages)
        const offset = (page - 1) * limit

        const flowRows = await db
          .select({
            traceId: aiReviewFlowRuns.traceId,
            reviewId: aiReviewFlowRuns.reviewId,
            status: aiReviewFlowRuns.status,
            personaMode: aiReviewFlowRuns.personaMode,
            persona: aiReviewFlowRuns.persona,
            personaPasses: aiReviewFlowRuns.personaPasses,
            startedAt: aiReviewFlowRuns.startedAt,
            lastEventAt: aiReviewFlowRuns.lastEventAt,
            finishedAt: aiReviewFlowRuns.finishedAt,
            latestError: aiReviewFlowRuns.latestError,
          })
          .from(aiReviewFlowRuns)
          .where(flowWhere)
          .orderBy(desc(aiReviewFlowRuns.startedAt), desc(aiReviewFlowRuns.createdAt))
          .limit(limit)
          .offset(offset) as AiReviewFlowRunRow[]

        const traceIds = flowRows.map((row) => row.traceId)
        const logSampleLimit = Math.min(MAX_ROW_SCAN, Math.max(traceIds.length * 60, 400))
        const flowEventSampleLimit = Math.min(MAX_ROW_SCAN, Math.max(traceIds.length * 120, 400))
        const sampleLimit = logSampleLimit + flowEventSampleLimit

        let rows: AiRunLogRow[] = []
        let flowEventRows: AiReviewFlowEventRow[] = []

if (traceIds.length > 0) {
          rows = await db
            .select({
              id: appLogEvents.id,
              timestamp: appLogEvents.timestamp,
              level: appLogEvents.level,
              event: appLogEvents.event,
              requestId: appLogEvents.requestId,
              path: appLogEvents.path,
              status: appLogEvents.status,
              durationMs: appLogEvents.durationMs,
              payload: appLogEvents.payload,
            })
            .from(appLogEvents)
            .where(
              and(
                gte(appLogEvents.timestamp, since),
                lte(appLogEvents.timestamp, until),
                inArray(appLogEvents.requestId, traceIds),
                sql`${appLogEvents.event} like ${"api.review.%"}`,
              ),
            )
            .orderBy(desc(appLogEvents.timestamp), desc(appLogEvents.createdAt))
            .limit(logSampleLimit) as AiRunLogRow[]

# @argus/argus-search

Rust-powered code indexing core with Node (N-API) and Python (PyO3) bindings. Designed for AI code search and deep codebase understanding.

## Features

- Tree-sitter parsing into chunk batches.
- Syntax graph + optional semantic graph via SCIP.
- Vector embeddings via HTTP provider.
- Index-pack JSONL output for BYODB ingestion.
- Phase events for progress + metrics.
- Optional file cache (mtime + hash) for incremental runs.

## Support Matrix

- Languages (tree-sitter chunking): JavaScript, TypeScript/TSX, Python, Rust, C, C++, Java, C#, Ada.
- Semantic indexing (SCIP): TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C/C++.
- Optional SCIP indexers: Java and C# can be enabled via `scip.indexerConfig.java` / `scip.indexerConfig.csharp` command config.
- Semantic graph edges from SCIP include `IMPORTS`, `REFERENCES`, `CALLS`, `CALLED_BY`, and relationship-driven edges such as `IMPLEMENTS`, `EXTENDS`, `HAS_TYPE`, `OVERRIDES`.
- Symbol parity (chunk kinds):

| Language       | function | class | type | variable |
| -------------- | -------- | ----- | ---- | -------- |
| JavaScript     | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| TypeScript/TSX | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| Python         | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| Rust           | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| C              | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| C++            | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| Java           | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| C#             | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |
| Ada            | ✅       | ✅    | ✅   | ✅       |

- Platforms (Node native): macOS (arm64/x64), Linux (x64-gnu), Windows (x64).
- Python: built via maturin (CPython 3.9+).

## Node Usage

### Fluent SDK (recommended)

```ts
import { Indexer, KiteDB } from '@argus/argus-search'

const ix = new Indexer() // defaults root to process.cwd()
ix.paths('src').include('*.ts', '*.tsx').exclude('node_modules', 'dist')
ix.useVectors({ model: 'text-embedding-3-small' }) // defaults apiKey to OPENAI_API_KEY

const db = new KiteDB() // defaults to "<root>/.argus-search/index.kite"
const run = await ix.persist({ db, clear: true })
console.log(`indexed ${run.fileCount} files in ${run.duration.toFixed(2)}s`)

const hits = await ix.search('Where is vector indexing implemented?', { db, topK: 5 })
for (const hit of hits) {
  console.log(hit.score, hit.chunkId, hit.filePath)
}
```

Customization points:

- `new Indexer({ root, paths, include, exclude, respectGitignore })`
- `ix.paths(...)`, `ix.include(...)`, `ix.exclude(...)`, `ix.useGitignore(false)`
- `ix.useVectors({ model, apiKey, baseUrl, dimension, timeoutMs, batchSize, concurrency })`
- `ix.index({ graph, vector, scip, indexPack, batchSize })`
- `ix.persist({ db, clear, graph, vector, scip, indexPack, batchSize })`
- `new KiteDB({ root, path })`

### Agent DX helpers

If you want a minimal “index + search + tool contract” wrapper (no custom store required), use `createArgusSearch()`:

```ts
import { createArgusSearch } from '@argus/argus-search/agent'

const ci = createArgusSearch({
  projectRoot: '/repo',
  inputs: { paths: ['src'], include: ['*.ts', '*.tsx'], exclude: ['node_modules', 'dist', '.git'] },
  vectorProvider: { kind: 'http', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8080', model: 'text-embedding-3-small', dimension: 1536 },
})

await ci.index()
const matches = await ci.tool.execute({ query: 'Where is the vector provider implemented?', topK: 5 })
```

### Extensible chunking (plugin-ready)

For direct chunking (without full indexing), call `chunkFile()`:

```ts
import { chunkFile } from '@argus/argus-search'

const chunks = chunkFile({
  filePath: 'src/example.ts',
  content: 'export function hello() { return 1 }',
})
```

Or load content directly from disk:

```ts
const chunks = chunkFile({
  filePath: 'src/example.ts',
  contentPath: './src/example.ts',
})
```

To add language support at runtime, register a language plugin once, then index/chunk normally.
You provide:

- grammar source (`builtin` parser alias or `dylib` tree-sitter grammar)
- file extensions
- query set (`functions`, `classes`, `types`, `variables`, `imports`, `exports`, `comments`)
- chunk kinds to emit

```ts
import { registerChunkLanguage } from '@argus/argus-search'

registerChunkLanguage({
  id: 'my-tsx',
  extensions: ['.mtsx'],
  grammar: { kind: 'builtin', builtin: 'typescript' },
  queriesDir: './queries/typescript',
  queryPaths: {
    functions: './queries/typescript/functions.scm',
  },
  queries: {
    functions: '(function_declaration name: (identifier) @symbol.name) @chunk.function',
    classes: '(class_declaration name: (type_identifier) @symbol.name) @chunk.class',
    imports: '(import_statement source: (string) @import.source)',
    exports: '(export_statement) @export.default',
    comments: '(comment) @comment.block',
  },
  chunkKinds: ['function', 'class'],
})
```

After registration, `Indexer` indexing methods and `chunkFile()` resolve matching files through your plugin first.

### Low-level API (compat)

The object-based SDK above is preferred. Low-level functions are still available when you need full schema-level control:

```ts
import { indexToKiteDb, searchKiteDb, traceImpactKiteDb } from '@argus/argus-search'

await indexToKiteDb(
  {
    projectRoot: '/repo',
    inputs: { paths: ['src'], include: ['*.ts', '*.tsx'], exclude: ['node_modules', 'dist', '.git'] },
    phases: { parse: true, graph: true, vector: true, scip: false, indexPack: false },
    vector: {
      provider: { kind: 'http', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8080', model: 'text-embedding-3-small', dimension: 1536 },
    },
  },
  { path: '.argus-search/index.kite', clear: false },
)

const hits = await searchKiteDb({
  projectRoot: '/repo',
  store: { path: '.argus-search/index.kite' },
  query: 'Where is the vector provider implemented?',
  topK: 5,
  vectorProvider: { kind: 'http', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8080', model: 'text-embedding-3-small', dimension: 1536 },
})

const impact = await traceImpactKiteDb({
  projectRoot: '/repo',
  store: { path: '.argus-search/index.kite' },
  name: 'runSearch',
  depth: 3,
  limit: 200,
})
```

### Dogfood benchmark (KiteDB, end-to-end)

Run the full pipeline against this package (parse + graph + vector), persist to KiteDB, then validate with `searchKiteDb` + `traceCallersKiteDb`:

```bash
yarn bench:dogfood
```

Useful overrides:

- `--project-root /path/to/repo` target a different repo.
- `--store .argus-search/dogfood/index.kite` keep a reusable KiteDB artifact.
- `--results .argus-search/benchmarks/dogfood-latest.json` write benchmark metrics JSON.
- `--iterations 5 --warmup 1` control benchmark sampling.
- `--embedding-provider openai` (default) uses OpenAI-compatible embeddings and requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- `--embedding-provider auto` uses OpenAI when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set, otherwise falls back to a local mock server.
- `--embedding-provider mock` forces the local deterministic embeddings server.
- `--vector-model text-embedding-3-small` and `--vector-base-url https://api.openai.com/v1` customize the provider.
- `--no-vector` skips vector/search and benchmarks parse+graph only.

Default mode is real embeddings (`openai`) to dogfood production-like behavior.

### A/B benchmark vs grepai

Run a side-by-side benchmark that compares `ci` (Argus) and `grepai` on the same project and query set:

```bash
yarn bench:grepai --project-root /path/to/repo
```

By default this script:

- creates isolated temp copies of the project (so your working tree is untouched),
- runs warmup + measured passes for both tools,
- measures indexing plus query latency,
- uses `--argus-query-cache warm` (repeated-query workflow),
- uses `--argus-checkpoint-warmup on` (post-index checkpoint warmup),
- writes a JSON report to `.argus-search/benchmarks/argus-vs-grepai-latest.json`.

Useful overrides:

- `--argus-bin ./target/release/ci` to pin the Argus binary.
- `--grepai-bin grepai` to choose a grepai executable.
- `--queries "indexing pipeline,vector provider,trace callers"` to set the benchmark workload.
- `--iterations 5 --warmup 1` to tune sampling.
- `--argus-phases parse,graph,vector` to control Argus phases.
- `--argus-query-cache cold` for fair cold-query comparison (default is `warm`).
- `--argus-checkpoint-warmup off` to disable checkpoint warmup during indexing (`on|off|config`).
- `--embedding-mode mock` to run both tools against a shared local OpenAI-compatible mock endpoint.
- `--include-impact` to benchmark impact/trace analysis in addition to semantic search.
- `--impact-queries "Login,runSearch"` to pass symbol-like inputs for impact/trace (defaults to `--queries`).
- `--argus-impact-depth 10` to set Argus `--impact-depth` explicitly (defaults to grepai `--trace-depth` when using `trace graph`).
- `--grepai-trace-kind graph --trace-mode precise --trace-depth 3` to control grepai trace behavior in impact mode.
- `--vector-model text-embedding-3-small --vector-dimension 1536` to keep embedding config aligned across Argus and grepai.
- `--grepai-backend gob` to control grepai storage backend.
- `--dry-run` to print commands without executing.

### Async Iterator

Use `ix.stream()` for the same async iterator behavior with fluent defaults:

```ts
import { Indexer, StreamEventType } from '@argus/argus-search'

const ix = new Indexer({ root: '/repo' })
ix.paths('src').include('*.ts', '*.tsx')
ix.useVectors({ model: 'text-embedding-3-small' })

Runnable, self-contained demo (local embedding server + in-memory cosine search):

```bash
bun examples/node/agent-rag.ts
```

### Path resolution (important)

Any **relative** paths in options are resolved **against `projectRoot`** (Node) / `project_root` (Python):

- `inputs.paths`
- `output.dataDir`, `output.indexPackDir`
- `cache.path`
- `scip.dataDir`
- `scip.indexerConfig.clang.compileCommandsPath`

So `output: { indexPackDir: ".argus-search/index-pack" }` writes into `<projectRoot>/.argus-search/index-pack` regardless of `process.cwd()`.

## Python Usage

```py
from argus_search import Indexer, KiteDB
from argus_search.events import PipelineComplete, VectorBatch

ix = Indexer()  # defaults root to current working directory
ix.paths("src").include("*.py", "*.ts").exclude("__pycache__", ".venv")
ix.use_vectors(model="text-embedding-3-small")  # defaults api_key to OPENAI_API_KEY

db = KiteDB()  # defaults to "<root>/.argus-search/index.kite"

# Persist parse + graph + vector into KiteDB.
run = ix.persist(db, clear=True)
print(f"Indexed {run.file_count} files in {run.duration:.2f}s")

# Typed stream events for progress/UI integrations.
for event in ix.stream(batch_size=16):
  match event:
    case VectorBatch(records):

### MCP server (daemon)

Run a local MCP-over-HTTP (SSE) server exposing `code_search`, `code_open`, and `code_reindex`:

```bash

```

Tool transport: `POST /mcp` with JSON-RPC (`tools/list`, `tools/call`), response is `text/event-stream`.

### MCP server (stdio, recommended)

Most MCP clients expect a **stdio** server (newline-delimited JSON-RPC). This mode is the most compatible with tools like Cline / Claude Desktop / Claude Code:

```bash
argus-search mcp --config argus-search.json
```

The server requires `vector.provider` (HTTP embeddings) and uses a KiteDB file store (default: `.argus-search/index.kite` under `projectRoot`).

### MCP server (pure Rust binary)

For a single-executable MCP server (no Node runtime), build and run:

```bash
cargo build --release --bin argus-search-mcp
./target/release/argus-search-mcp --config argus-search.json
```

This Rust binary runs **MCP over stdio** (there is **no port**). In a typical MCP client UI:

- Transport: `STDIO`
- Command: `argus-search-mcp` (or an absolute path)
- Arguments: `--config argus-search.json --no-index-on-start`
- Working directory: your repo root (where `argus-search.json` lives)
- Environment variable passthrough: `OPENAI_API_KEY` (required for indexing if `vector.provider.apiKey` is not set)

Tip: add `--verbose` (or `--log-level debug`) to see connection/indexing logs on stderr.
This binary speaks MCP over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC) and exposes the same `code_search`, `code_open`, `code_reindex` tools.

CLI options override the JSON config file if provided. The CLI will search upward from the current directory for `argus-search.json` or `.argus-search.json` by default.
If `projectRoot` is not set, it defaults to the config file’s directory (if found), otherwise the current working directory.

### Example config file

`argus-search.json`:

```json
{
  "projectRoot": "/repo",
  "inputs": {
    "paths": ["src"],
    "include": ["*.ts", "*.tsx"],
    "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", ".git"]
  },
  "phases": { "parse": true, "graph": true, "vector": false, "scip": false, "indexPack": true },
  "output": { "indexPackDir": ".argus-search/index-pack", "incremental": true },
  "cache": { "enabled": true }
}
```

## Cache (Incremental Parse)

Enable cache for `mtime + hash` skipping:

```ts
await index({
  projectRoot: '/repo',
  output: { incremental: true },
  cache: { enabled: true },
})
```

Use `cache.force: true` to bypass cache.

## Include/Exclude semantics

File discovery accepts both extension-style patterns and globs:

- `inputs.include` (if set) is an allowlist. Common forms:
  - Extensions: `"ts"`, `".ts"`, `"*.ts"` (all treated like `"**/*.ts"`).
  - Globs: `"src/**/*.ts"`, `"**/*.test.ts"`.
- `inputs.exclude` blocks matches by:
  - Exact entry name (e.g. `"node_modules"`, `".git"`),
  - Substring match against the normalized relative path,
  - Glob match (e.g. `"**/*.min.js"`, `"dist/**"`).

Notes:

- Relative-path glob matching uses `/` separators (Windows paths are normalized).
- Invalid glob patterns fail the run early (instead of silently indexing nothing).
- File discovery respects `.gitignore` by default. Disable via `inputs.respectGitignore: false` (Node/JSON config), `inputs.respect_gitignore: false` (Python), or `--no-gitignore` (CLI).

## Events

`hooks.onEvent` receives:

- `phase:start` (`phase`, `timestamp`)
- `phase:progress` (`phase`, `current`, `total`, optional `file`, `detail`)
- `phase:complete` (`phase`, `durationMs`, optional `stats`)
- `phase:error` (`phase`, `error`, `recoverable`)
- `pipeline:complete` (`durationMs`, `stats`, optional `errors`)

## Robust usage tips

- Prefer `phases: { parse: true, graph: true, indexPack: true }` as a “safe default”. `vector` and `scip` add external dependencies (HTTP + indexers) and will fail the run if misconfigured.
- Keep `inputs.paths` narrow (e.g. `["src"]`) and always set `exclude` for `node_modules`, build outputs, and vendored code.
- For large repos, reduce memory/latency by tuning `hooks.parseBatch` / `hooks.graphBatch` and `vector.concurrency`.

## Security-sensitive environment toggles

These environment variables intentionally relax default safety checks and should only be used for trusted local development.

- `CODE_INTELLIGENCE_ALLOW_UNSAFE_SCIP_COMMANDS=1`
  - Disables SCIP command allowlist and PATH/name validation.
  - Allows arbitrary configured commands to execute in SCIP indexing.
- `CODE_INTELLIGENCE_ALLOW_UNSAFE_GRAMMARS=1`
  - Allows loading external tree-sitter dynamic libraries via `registerChunkLanguage`.
  - Dynamic libraries execute native code in-process; only load grammars you trust.

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

from argus_search import Indexer, KiteDB
from argus_search.events import PipelineComplete, VectorBatch


# Optional overrides for local runs.
PROJECT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("PROJECT_ROOT", Path.cwd()))
QUERY = os.environ.get("CODE_INTEL_QUERY", "Where is vector indexing implemented?")


def main() -> None:
    # `Indexer()` defaults to cwd and respects .gitignore.
    ix = Indexer(root=str(PROJECT_ROOT))
    ix.paths("src").include("*.py", "*.ts", "*.tsx", "*.js", "*.jsx", "*.rs")
    ix.exclude("__pycache__", ".venv", "node_modules", "dist")

    # Defaults:
    # - base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1
    # - api_key: OPENAI_API_KEY
    ix.use_vectors(model="text-embedding-3-small", dimension=1536, batch_size=32, concurrency=4)

    # `KiteDB()` defaults to "<root>/.argus-search/index.kite".
    db = KiteDB(root=str(PROJECT_ROOT))

    run = ix.persist(db, clear=True)
    print(f"Indexed {run.file_count} files in {run.duration:.2f}s -> {db.path}")

    # Optional: stream typed events for progress/UI reporting.
    for event in ix.stream(batch_size=32):
        match event:
            case VectorBatch(records):
                print(f"vector batch: {len(records)} records")
            case PipelineComplete(stats):
                print(f"stream complete: {stats.file_count} files in {stats.duration:.2f}s")

    hits = ix.search(QUERY, db=db, top_k=5)
    for idx, hit in enumerate(hits, 1):
        print(f"{idx}. {hit.score:.4f} {hit.chunk_id} {hit.file_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    prefetch: (href: string) => void
    replace: (href: string) => void
  }
  projectsCacheKey: string
  projects: Project[]
  queryClient: Parameters<typeof useOnboardingMrPrefetch>[0]["queryClient"]
  mergeRequestsQueryKey: Parameters<typeof useOnboardingMrPrefetch>[0]["mergeRequestsQueryKey"]
  callGitLab: Parameters<typeof useOnboardingMrPrefetch>[0]["callGitLab"]

  recentProjects: Project[]
  mergeRequests: MergeRequest[]

export function useOnboardingFlowEffects({
  projectSelectionHandlerRef,
  mergeRequestSelectionHandlerRef,
  handleProjectSelection,
  handleMergeRequestSelection,
  isHydrated,
  routeStep,
  trackEvent,
  token,
  selectedProjectId,
  router,
  projectsCacheKey,
  projects,
  queryClient,
  mergeRequestsQueryKey,
  callGitLab,
  actionBusy,
  recentProjects,
  mergeRequests,
}: UseOnboardingFlowEffectsOptions) {
  useEffect(() => {
    projectSelectionHandlerRef.current = handleProjectSelection
    mergeRequestSelectionHandlerRef.current = handleMergeRequestSelection
  }, [handleProjectSelection, handleMergeRequestSelection, projectSelectionHandlerRef, mergeRequestSelectionHandlerRef])

  useOnboardingStartedTracking({ isHydrated, routeStep, trackEvent })

  useOnboardingRouteGuards({
    isHydrated,
    routeStep,
    token,
    selectedProjectId,
    router,
  })

  useOnboardingMrPrefetch({
    isHydrated,
    routeStep,
    projectsCacheKey,
    projects,
    selectedProjectId,
    queryClient,
    mergeRequestsQueryKey,
    callGitLab,
  })

  useOnboardingDigitShortcuts({
    isHydrated,
    routeStep,
    actionBusy,
    recentProjects,
    mergeRequests,
    shortcutLimit: RECENT_PROJECTS_LIMIT,
    projectSelectionHandlerRef,
    mergeRequestSelectionHandlerRef,
  })
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"

PACK_JSON="$(cd "$ROOT_DIR" && npm pack --ignore-scripts --json)"
TARBALL_NAME="$(node -e "const out = JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); process.stdout.write(out[out.length - 1].filename);" "$PACK_JSON")"
TARBALL_PATH="$ROOT_DIR/$TARBALL_NAME"

if [ ! -f "$TARBALL_PATH" ]; then
  echo "Tarball not found: $TARBALL_PATH"
  exit 1
fi

for required in \
  "package/index.js" \
  "package/js/agent.js" \
  "package/js/mcp.js" \
  "package/js/mcp-stdio.js" \
  "package/js/cli.js"; do
  if ! tar -tzf "$TARBALL_PATH" | grep -q "^$required\$"; then
    echo "Missing required file in tarball: $required"
    exit 1
  fi
done

if ! tar -tzf "$TARBALL_PATH" | grep -q "^package/native/.*\\.node$"; then
  echo "Missing native binding in tarball under package/native/"
  exit 1
fi

TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
cleanup() {
  rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

cd "$TMP_DIR"
npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1
npm install "$TARBALL_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1

node -e "const root=require('@argus/argus-search'); const agent=require('@argus/argus-search/agent'); const mcp=require('@argus/argus-search/mcp'); if (!root.index || !agent.createArgusSearch || !mcp.createMcpServer) process.exit(1);"
node node_modules/@argus/argus-search/js/cli.js help mcp >/dev/null

echo "Node package verification passed for $TARBALL_NAME"

import json
import pathlib
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

from argus_search import Indexer
from argus_search.events import PipelineComplete, VectorBatch


class EmbeddingsHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):  # noqa: N802
        if self.path != "/embeddings":
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"not found")
            return

        content_length = int(self.headers.get("content-length", "0"))
        raw = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        try:
            payload = json.loads(raw)
            input_count = len(payload.get("input", [])) if isinstance(payload.get("input"), list) else 1
        except Exception:
            input_count = 1

        embedding = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
        data = [{"embedding": embedding} for _ in range(input_count)]

        body = json.dumps({"data": data}).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):  # noqa: A003
        return


def start_server() -> tuple[str, callable]:
    httpd = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), EmbeddingsHandler)
    host, port = httpd.server_address
    thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return f"http://{host}:{port}", lambda: httpd.shutdown()

name: CI
env:
  DEBUG: napi:*
  APP_NAME: code-intelligence
  MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '10.13'
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '1'
'on':
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags-ignore:
      - '**'
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - LICENSE
      - '**/*.gitignore'
      - .editorconfig
      - docs/**
  pull_request: null
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: Oxlint
        run: yarn lint
      - name: Cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy
  dogfood-benchmark:
    name: Dogfood benchmark (KiteDB)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: Build native binding (debug)
        run: yarn build:debug
      - name: Run dogfood benchmark
        run: yarn bench:dogfood -- --iterations 1 --warmup 0 --embedding-provider auto --results .code-intelligence/benchmarks/ci-dogfood.json

env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      - name: Upload dogfood artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: dogfood-benchmark
          path: |
            .code-intelligence/benchmarks/ci-dogfood.json
            .code-intelligence/dogfood/index.kite
          if-no-files-found: error
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        settings:
          - host: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            build: yarn build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
          - host: windows-latest
            build: yarn build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - host: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build: yarn build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --use-napi-cross
          - host: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            build: yarn build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
    name: stable - ${{ matrix.settings.target }} - node@22
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.settings.host }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/

~/.napi-rs
            .cargo-cache
            target/
          key: ${{ matrix.settings.target }}-cargo-${{ matrix.settings.host }}
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2
        if: ${{ contains(matrix.settings.target, 'musl') }}
        with:
          version: 0.14.1
      - name: Install cargo-zigbuild
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        if: ${{ contains(matrix.settings.target, 'musl') }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild
      - name: Setup toolchain
        run: ${{ matrix.settings.setup }}
        if: ${{ matrix.settings.setup }}
        shell: bash
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: Build
        run: ${{ matrix.settings.build }}
        shell: bash
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: bindings-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          path: |
            ${{ env.APP_NAME }}.*.node
            ${{ env.APP_NAME }}.*.wasm
          if-no-files-found: error
  test-macOS-windows-binding:
    name: Test bindings on ${{ matrix.settings.target }} - node@${{ matrix.node }}
    needs:
      - build
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        settings:
          - host: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            architecture: x64
          - host: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            architecture: arm64
          - host: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            architecture: x64
        node:
          - '20'

- '22'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.settings.host }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: yarn
          architecture: ${{ matrix.settings.architecture }}
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: bindings-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          path: .
      - name: List packages
        run: ls -R .
        shell: bash
      - name: Test bindings
        run: yarn test
  test-linux-binding:
    name: Test ${{ matrix.target }} - node@${{ matrix.node }}
    needs:
      - build
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target:
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        node:
          - '20'
          - '22'
    runs-on: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'aarch64') && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: yarn
      - name: Output docker params
        id: docker
        run: |
          node -e "
            if ('${{ matrix.target }}'.startsWith('aarch64')) {
              console.log('PLATFORM=linux/arm64')
            } else if ('${{ matrix.target }}'.startsWith('armv7')) {
              console.log('PLATFORM=linux/arm/v7')
            } else {
              console.log('PLATFORM=linux/amd64')
            }
          " >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

node -e "
            if ('${{ matrix.target }}'.endsWith('-musl')) {
              console.log('IMAGE=node:${{ matrix.node }}-alpine')
            } else {
              console.log('IMAGE=node:${{ matrix.node }}-slim')
            }
          " >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          yarn config set --json supportedArchitectures.cpu '["current", "arm64", "x64", "arm"]'
          yarn config set --json supportedArchitectures.libc '["current", "musl", "gnu"]'
          yarn install
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: bindings-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: .
      - name: List packages
        run: ls -R .
        shell: bash
      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        if: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'armv7') }}
        with:
          platforms: all
      - run: docker run --rm --privileged multiarch/qemu-user-static --reset -p yes
        if: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'armv7') }}
      - name: Test bindings
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.docker.outputs.IMAGE }}
          options: '-v ${{ github.workspace }}:${{ github.workspace }} -w ${{ github.workspace }} --platform ${{ steps.docker.outputs.PLATFORM }}'
          run: yarn test
  publish:
    name: Publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    needs:
      - lint
      - dogfood-benchmark
      - test-macOS-windows-binding
      - test-linux-binding
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

- name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: create npm dirs
        run: yarn napi create-npm-dirs
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          path: artifacts
      - name: Move artifacts
        run: yarn artifacts
      - name: Verify node package
        run: yarn release:check-node-package
      - name: List packages
        run: ls -R ./npm
        shell: bash
      - name: Publish
        run: |
          npm config set provenance true
          if git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep "^[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+$";
          then
            echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=$NPM_TOKEN" >> ~/.npmrc
            npm publish --access public
          elif git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep "^[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+";
          then
            echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=$NPM_TOKEN" >> ~/.npmrc
            npm publish --tag next --access public
          else
            echo "Not a release, skipping publish"
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

const truncateError = (message: string, maxLength = 500) =>
  message.length <= maxLength ? message : `${message.slice(0, maxLength)}...`

const integrationToSummary = (integration: GitLabIntegration): GitLabIntegrationSummary => ({
  id: integration.id,
  instanceUrl: integration.instanceUrl,
  projectId: integration.projectId,
  projectPath: integration.projectPath,
  projectName: integration.projectName,

})

export const getIntegrationById = (integrationId: string) =>
  withGitLabSchemaHint(() =>
    db.query.gitlabIntegrations.findFirst({ where: eq(gitlabIntegrations.id, integrationId) }),
  )

export const listUserIntegrations = async (userId: string): Promise<GitLabIntegrationSummary[]> => {
  const rows = await withGitLabSchemaHint(() =>
    db
      .select({ integration: gitlabIntegrations })
      .from(gitlabIntegrationMemberships)
      .innerJoin(
        gitlabIntegrations,
        eq(gitlabIntegrationMemberships.integrationId, gitlabIntegrations.id),
      )
      .where(eqGitLabMembershipUserId(userId))
      .orderBy(gitlabIntegrations.projectPath),
  )

  return rows.map((row) => integrationToSummary(row.integration))
}

import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'

import { db } from '@/lib/db'
import { indexJobs, indexRuns } from '@/lib/db/schema'

const toNumber = (value: unknown) => {
  const parsed = Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0
}

export const getQueueDepthSnapshot = async (): Promise<QueueDepthSnapshot> => {
  const [jobsDepthResult, runsDepthResult] = await Promise.all([
    db.execute(sql`
      select
        count(*) filter (where ${indexJobs.status} = 'pending') as "jobsPending",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexJobs.status} = 'processing') as "jobsProcessing",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexJobs.status} = 'failed') as "jobsFailed",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexJobs.status} = 'dead') as "jobsDead"
      from ${indexJobs}
    `),
    db.execute(sql`
      select
        count(*) filter (where ${indexRuns.status} = 'planned') as "runsPlanned",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexRuns.status} = 'ingesting') as "runsIngesting",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexRuns.status} = 'indexing') as "runsIndexing",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexRuns.status} = 'cancelled') as "runsCancelled",
        count(*) filter (where ${indexRuns.status} = 'failed') as "runsFailed"
      from ${indexRuns}
    `),
  ])

  const jobsDepthRow = jobsDepthResult.rows[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
  const runsDepthRow = runsDepthResult.rows[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined

return {
    jobsPending: toNumber(jobsDepthRow?.jobsPending),
    jobsProcessing: toNumber(jobsDepthRow?.jobsProcessing),
    jobsFailed: toNumber(jobsDepthRow?.jobsFailed),
    jobsDead: toNumber(jobsDepthRow?.jobsDead),
    runsPlanned: toNumber(runsDepthRow?.runsPlanned),
    runsIngesting: toNumber(runsDepthRow?.runsIngesting),
    runsIndexing: toNumber(runsDepthRow?.runsIndexing),
    runsCancelled: toNumber(runsDepthRow?.runsCancelled),
    runsFailed: toNumber(runsDepthRow?.runsFailed),
  }
}

chunks.text:
# Indexing Overview

This document describes how indexing currently works in `argus`.

## Goals

- Keep branch-level code search/index state current from GitLab events.
- Support first-time snapshot indexing and incremental delta indexing.
- Protect serving state from partial/failed runs.
- Recover from missed webhook events.
- Keep artifacts bounded via retention cleanup.
- Emit baseline observability for operations.

## High-level Architecture

- API layer (Next.js)
  - Receives GitLab webhooks.
  - Exposes user-facing indexing endpoints.
  - Exposes internal runner/cleanup endpoints.
- GitLab job runner
  - Processes webhook-derived `gitlab_jobs`.
  - Enqueues indexing `plan` / `reconcile` jobs.
- Indexer worker
  - Claims indexing jobs and planned runs.
  - Runs planner/reconcile/ingest/finalize flows.
- PostgreSQL
  - Source of truth for branch/run/job state.
  - Stores vectors (`pgvector`) and embeddings cache.
- Artifact store
  - FS or S3 backend for run artifacts.

## End-to-end Flow

1. GitLab webhook arrives at `POST /api/webhooks/gitlab/[integrationId]`.
2. Delivery is normalized/deduped and written as a `gitlab_job`.
3. Internal GitLab job runner (`POST /api/internal/gitlab-jobs/run`) processes webhook jobs.
4. For push events:
   - Enqueue `plan` job for branch head (`index_jobs`) when push is not a branch-delete event.
   - Enqueue `reconcile` job (`index_jobs`).
5. For merge request events:
   - `open/reopen/update` can auto-queue source-branch indexing.
   - `merge/close` enqueue reconcile to accelerate branch lifecycle checks.
6. Indexer worker (`bun run worker:indexer`) runs batches:
   - Optional artifact cleanup pass.
   - Periodic reconcile scheduling.
   - Claim/process due `index_jobs` (`plan`, `reconcile`).
   - Claim/process due planned `index_runs` via ingest.
7. Ingest path updates vectors and staged file changes.
8. Finalize uses CAS semantics to atomically promote serving pointer.
9. Reconcile marks missing branches `pending_prune` and prunes after grace (artifact delete first, then branch state delete).
10. Result status becomes `ready`, `failed`, or `superseded`.

## Core Data Model

### Configuration and Branch Serving State

- `index_configs`: config payload/hash per integration.
- `index_branch_states`: branch + config serving pointer.
  - `lastReadySha`
  - `lastReadyRunId`
  - `servingUpdatedAt`

### Runs and Jobs

- `index_runs`
  - mode: `snapshot | delta`
  - status: `planned | ingesting | indexing | ready | failed | superseded`
  - unique `(branchStateId, headSha)` for idempotent planning.
- `index_jobs`
  - type: `plan | reconcile`
  - status: `pending | processing | failed | succeeded | dead`
  - debounced by unique `debounceKey`.

### File and Vector State

- `index_run_file_changes`: staged per-run file mutations (`upsert | delete`).
- `index_file_states`: live serving file state per branch/path.
- `index_vectors`: chunk vectors bound to branch/run/path/file.
- `index_embedding_cache`: optional embedding cache by chunk/model.

## Planning Logic

Planner (`processPlanJob`) does:

- Resolve head SHA from GitLab (optionally honoring hinted SHA).
- Upsert config + branch state records.
- Decide run mode:
  - `snapshot` when no base SHA or delta disabled/unsafe.
  - `delta` when compare is valid and within threshold.
- Create/reuse `index_runs` row (idempotent by branch/head).
- Support forced replan (`plan-force:*` debounce key) for manual rebuild.

## Ingest and Finalize Logic

Ingest (`processIngestJob`) does:

- Move run `planned -> indexing`.
- Execute:
  - snapshot ingest, or
  - delta ingest with snapshot fallback when needed.
- Write run stats including fallback metadata.
- Finalize run via CAS:
  - branch pointer promoted only if expected base still current.
  - CAS miss marks run `superseded`.
- If finalized `ready`, run stale vector cleanup by staged paths.

Safety properties:

- Failed ingest cannot update serving pointer.
- Out-of-order older runs cannot overwrite newer serving state.
- Repeated job delivery is deduped at queue/run uniqueness boundaries.

## Reconcile (Missed Webhook Recovery)

Reconcile ensures stale branches are re-enqueued even if webhooks are missed.

- Scheduler enqueues due reconcile jobs periodically (`index_jobs`), bounded by integration limit.
- Reconcile processor checks each tracked branch:
  - resolve default branch for prune protection
  - resolve current head SHA
  - compare with `lastReadySha`
  - enqueue plan job when stale
  - when branch is missing (404): set `pending_prune_at` and prune after grace when branch is not default
- Reconcile result metadata (`checked`, `enqueued`, `missing`, `scheduledForPrune`, `pruned`, `pruneErrors`, `branchChecks`) is persisted in job `result`.
- `index/runs` and `index/branches` APIs expose latest reconcile state.

## Artifact Storage and Cleanup

Artifacts are written per run under `artifactsPrefix`.

Backends:

- FS (`INDEXER_ARTIFACTS_BACKEND=fs`, default)
- S3 (`INDEXER_ARTIFACTS_BACKEND=s3`)

Graph snapshot availability:

- `Graph Ready` requires graph snapshot artifacts (`index-pack.manifest.json`, `graph.nodes.jsonl`, `graph.edges.jsonl`) to be readable by the app runtime.
- In split web/indexer deployments, use shared object storage (`s3`) for both services.
- Local Docker development can use the bundled MinIO service in `docker-compose.yml` with:
  - `INDEXER_ARTIFACTS_BACKEND=s3`
  - `INDEXER_S3_ENDPOINT=http://minio:9000`
  - `INDEXER_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=true`
  - `INDEXER_S3_BUCKET=argus-index-artifacts`

Retention cleanup (`cleanupIndexArtifacts`) policy:

- Keep latest N ready runs per branch (`readyKeepPerBranch`, default `1`).
- Age-based delete for failed and superseded runs.
- Optional global size cap enforcement.
- Delete limit per pass for controlled churn.
- Never deletes current serving run artifacts.
- Marks pruned runs by prefixing `artifactsPrefix` with `pruned:`.
- Re-runnable safely; concurrent pass guarded in-process.

Cleanup execution:

- Retention cleanup runs inside the indexer worker loop (interval-driven).

## Public API Surface

### User-facing

- `POST /api/gitlab/integrations/[integrationId]/index/enable`
  - Enables indexing for branch and enqueues:
    - plan job
    - reconcile job
- `POST /api/gitlab/integrations/[integrationId]/index/reindex`
  - Force replan for branch (`forceReplan=true`).
- `GET /api/gitlab/integrations/[integrationId]/index/runs`
  - Run list + pagination + latest reconcile summary.
- `GET /api/gitlab/integrations/[integrationId]/index/branches`
  - Branch serving state + last run + reconcile-per-branch visibility.
  - Includes `lastReadyGraphSnapshotStatus`; `ready` means graph artifacts are readable/usable by the app runtime.
- `GET /api/gitlab/integrations/[integrationId]/index/logs/stream`
  - SSE stream for realtime indexer worker/job/run logs scoped to integration.

### Internal

- `POST /api/internal/gitlab-jobs/run`
  - Drains webhook job queue and enqueues indexing jobs.
- `POST /api/internal/gitlab-jobs/cleanup`
  - Cleans old webhook deliveries.

## Worker Runtime

Command:

```bash
bun run worker:indexer
```

Important env:

- `INDEXER_BATCH_SIZE`
- `INDEXER_POLL_MS`
- `INDEXER_CONTINUOUS` (`1` for long-running loop)
- `INDEXER_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS`
- `INDEXER_RECONCILE_INTEGRATION_LIMIT`
- `INDEXER_BRANCH_PRUNE_ENABLED`
- `INDEXER_BRANCH_PRUNE_GRACE_MS`
- `INDEXER_BRANCH_PRUNE_MAX_PER_JOB`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXER_BRANCH_PRUNE_GRACE_MS` (optional UI countdown override; defaults to `86400000`)
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS`
- `APP_LOG_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_READY_KEEP_PER_BRANCH`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_FAILED_DAYS`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_SUPERSEDED_DAYS`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_CLEANUP_RUN_SCAN_LIMIT`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACT_CLEANUP_DELETE_LIMIT`
- `INDEXER_ARTIFACTS_BACKEND` (`fs` or `s3`)
- `INDEXER_S3_BUCKET`
- `INDEXER_S3_REGION`
- `INDEXER_S3_ENDPOINT`
- `INDEXER_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE`
- `INDEXER_S3_KEY_PREFIX`
- `INDEXER_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
- `INDEXER_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`
- `INDEXER_S3_SESSION_TOKEN`

Delta mode controls:

- `INDEXER_ENABLE_DELTA` (default-on unless explicitly false)
- `INDEXER_FORCE_SNAPSHOT` (emergency override)
- `INDEXER_DELTA_FALLBACK_THRESHOLD` (default `500`)

Embedding controls:

- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` (`openai` or `deterministic`)
- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_MODEL`
- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` (or `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `AI_API_TOKEN`)
- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS` (default `8000`, enforced conservatively via UTF-8 byte budget)
- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_MAX_REQUEST_TOKENS` (default `8000`, caps total estimated tokens per OpenAI embeddings request)
- `INDEXER_EMBEDDING_CHUNK_OVERLAP_TOKENS` (default `200`)

GitLab fetch reliability controls:

- `INDEXER_GITLAB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (default `15000`)
- `INDEXER_GITLAB_REQUEST_RETRIES` (default `2`)
- `INDEXER_GITLAB_ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES` (default `1073741824`)

MR auto-indexing controls:

- `INDEXER_AUTO_INDEX_MR_WEBHOOK_ENABLED` (default `1`)
- `INDEXER_AUTO_INDEX_MR_LAZY_ENABLED` (default `1`)
- `INDEXER_MR_PREWARM_ENABLED` (default `1`)
- `INDEXER_MR_PREWARM_LIMIT` (default `5`)

Repo materialization and graph controls:

- `INDEXER_SINGLE_ARCHIVE_ENABLED` (default `0`; enables shared workspace materialization)
- `INDEXER_SINGLE_ARCHIVE_ALLOWLIST` (comma-separated integration ids; empty means all)
- `INDEXER_GRAPH_FAIL_MODE` (`soft` or `hard`; default `hard` even when shared workspace mode is enabled)
- `INDEXER_GRAPH_REQUIRED` (legacy hard-fail toggle; still honored outside shared workspace mode)

App log retention controls:

- `APP_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` (default `30`)
- `APP_LOG_MAX_ROWS` (default `2000000`)
- `APP_LOG_CLEANUP_DELETE_LIMIT` (default `20000`)

## Observability

Primary events:

- `indexer.batch.processing`
  - queue depth before/after
  - job/run outcomes
  - fallback/finalize/gc counters
  - artifact cleanup summary
- `indexer.job.processing`
  - per plan/reconcile job outcome
  - reconcile lifecycle fields include `reconcileMissing`, `reconcileScheduledForPrune`, `reconcilePruned`, `reconcilePruneErrors`
  - reconcile branch lifecycle arrays include `pendingPruneScheduled`, `pruneSucceeded`, `pruneFailed`
- `indexer.run.processing`
  - status transition + fallback/finalize/gc fields

Runbook with SQL queries and baseline alert thresholds:

- `docs/indexing-observability-runbook.md`

## Performance Gate

Use the benchmark harness to validate the rollout gate before enabling shared workspace mode broadly.

```bash
bun run bench:indexing:phase2
bun run bench:indexing:phase2:set-baseline
bun run bench:indexing:phase2:check
```

Recommended gate for default-on rollout:

- median run wall-time improvement >= 25% on fixture set

## Operational Notes

- This repository currently uses a DB-backed queue model.
- Production needs external scheduling for internal routes and/or continuous workers.
- If queue grows:
  - increase worker concurrency/process count
  - tune batch size/poll interval
  - inspect `queueDepthBefore/After` and failure counters.

## Known Limits / Future Enhancements

- In-process cleanup lock is per worker process, not distributed.
- Reconcile scans tracked branches up to configured limit per job.
- Full distributed scheduler/worker orchestration can be added later if throughput grows.

fn build_index_run(
  duration_ms: u64,
  stats: &crate::core::index_engine::IndexStats,
  store_path: Option<String>,
) -> IndexRun {
  let (file_count, vector_count, graph_nodes, graph_edges) = (
    stats
      .parse
      .as_ref()
      .map(|parse| parse.files_parsed + parse.files_skipped)
      .unwrap_or(0),
    stats
      .vector
      .as_ref()
      .map(|vector| vector.vectors_emitted)
      .unwrap_or(0),
    stats
      .graph
      .as_ref()
      .map(|graph| graph.nodes_emitted)
      .unwrap_or(0),
    stats
      .graph
      .as_ref()
      .map(|graph| graph.edges_emitted)
      .unwrap_or(0),
  );

  IndexRun {
    duration: duration_ms as f64 / 1000.0,
    duration_ms,
    file_count,
    vector_count,
    graph_nodes,
    graph_edges,
    store_path,
  }
}

        and ${indexJobs.status} in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'dead')
        and coalesce(${indexJobs.finishedAt}, ${indexJobs.updatedAt}, ${indexJobs.createdAt}) <= ${dueBefore}
      returning ${indexJobs.id} as id
    )
    select id from upserted
  `

  const result = await db.execute(query)
  return result.rows.length
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
VERSION="$(node -p "require('$ROOT_DIR/package.json').version")"

TARBALL="$(ls "$ROOT_DIR"/*.tgz 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$TARBALL" ]; then
  echo "No npm tarball found in $ROOT_DIR"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Found tarball: $TARBALL"
tar -tzf "$TARBALL" | head -n 5 >/dev/null

WHEEL_DIR="$ROOT_DIR/target/wheels"
if [ ! -d "$WHEEL_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Wheel directory missing: $WHEEL_DIR"
  exit 1
fi

WHEEL_COUNT=$(ls "$WHEEL_DIR"/*.whl 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$WHEEL_COUNT" -lt 1 ]; then
  echo "No wheels found in $WHEEL_DIR"
  exit 1
fi

if ! ls "$WHEEL_DIR"/argus_search-"$VERSION"-*.whl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Wheel version does not match $VERSION"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Artifacts verified for version $VERSION"

export function useMergeRequestDiffModel({
  instanceUrl,
  token,
  integrationId,
  projectId,
  mergeRequestIid,
}: MergeRequestDiffViewerProps) {
  const ui = useMergeRequestDiffUiState()
  const ai = useMergeRequestAiReview({
    instanceUrl,
    token,
    integrationId,
    projectId,
    mergeRequestIid,
  })
  const data = useMergeRequestDiffData({
    instanceUrl,
    token,
    integrationId,
    projectId,
    mergeRequestIid,
    setCollapsedFileKeys: ui.setCollapsedFileKeys,
    onResetReview: ai.resetReviewState,
    onDiffLoaded: ai.loadLatestSavedReview,
    onResetVisibleFileCount: ui.resetVisibleFileCount,
  })
  const rendering = useMergeRequestDiffRendering({
    diffThemeMode: ui.diffThemeMode,
    diffStyle: ui.diffStyle,
    wrapLines: ui.wrapLines,
    showLineNumbers: ui.showLineNumbers,
  })

const derived = useMergeRequestDiffDerived({
    parsedFiles: data.parsedFiles,
    filenameFilter: ui.filenameFilter,
    patchText: data.patchText,
    visibleResetToken: ui.visibleResetToken,
    visibleWindow: ui.visibleWindow,
    dataSource: data.dataSource,
    loadProfile: data.loadProfile,
  })
  const review = useMergeRequestReviewMapping({
    parsedFiles: data.parsedFiles,
    reviewFindings: ai.reviewFindings,
    reviewCommentFeedbackByKey: ai.reviewCommentFeedbackByKey,
    reviewCommentFeedbackErrorByKey: ai.reviewCommentFeedbackErrorByKey,
    submittingReviewCommentFeedbackKeys: ai.submittingReviewCommentFeedbackKeys,
    reviewCommentPostedToGitLabKeys: ai.reviewCommentPostedToGitLabKeys,
    reviewCommentGitLabErrorByKey: ai.reviewCommentGitLabErrorByKey,
    submittingReviewCommentGitLabKeys: ai.submittingReviewCommentGitLabKeys,
    removingReviewCommentGitLabKeys: ai.removingReviewCommentGitLabKeys,
    reviewImpactByKey: ai.reviewImpactByKey,
    reviewImpactStatus: ai.reviewImpactStatus,
    isLoadingReviewImpact: ai.isLoadingReviewImpact,
    reviewImpactIndexing: ai.reviewImpactIndexing,
    isQueueingBranchIndexing: ai.isQueueingBranchIndexing,
    branchIndexingQueued: ai.branchIndexingQueued,
    branchIndexingError: ai.branchIndexingError,
  })
  const isDiffBusy = data.isLoading || data.isParsingInitialPatch
  const isDiffLoading =
    data.isLoading || data.isParsingInitialPatch || data.isParsingRemainingPatch

  return {
    ui,
    ai,
    data,
    rendering,
    derived,
    review,
    isDiffBusy,
    isDiffLoading,
  }
}

    }>

  } | null

    missingEvidence: number
  }

    personaMode: ReviewPersonaMode

    personaPasses: string[]
    strictness: "quiet" | "balanced" | "thorough"
    requireEvidence: boolean
    securityBoost: boolean
    scopeSource: string
  }
  filteredFindings: AiReviewFinding[]
  summary: string
  model: string
  integrationId: string | null
}

const inserted = await db
    .insert(aiReviewRuns)
    .values({
      userId: args.userId,
      instanceUrl,
      projectId,
      mergeRequestIid,
      integrationId: integration?.id ?? null,
      sourceBranch,
      sourceHeadSha,
      personaMode,
      persona,
      personaPasses,
      model,
      patchLength: patch.length,
      patchHash: sha256Hex(patch),
      findings: filteredFindings,
      findingsCount: filteredFindings.length,
      summary,
    })
    .returning({
      id: aiReviewRuns.id,
      summary: aiReviewRuns.summary,
      findings: aiReviewRuns.findings,
      personaMode: aiReviewRuns.personaMode,
      persona: aiReviewRuns.persona,
      personaPasses: aiReviewRuns.personaPasses,
      feedback: aiReviewRuns.feedback,
      createdAt: aiReviewRuns.createdAt,
    })

  const row = inserted[0] ?? null

  if (integration?.aiReviewAutoPostEnabled && row && filteredFindings.length > 0) {
    const upsertResult = await commentPublish.upsertPublicationsForReview({
      reviewId: row.id,
      integrationId: integration.id,
      userId: args.userId,
      instanceUrl,
      projectId,
      mergeRequestIid,
      findings: filteredFindings,
    })

    const queuedKeys = Object.entries(upsertResult.commentPublishByKey)
      .filter(([, state]) => state.status === "pending")
      .map(([commentKey]) => commentKey)
    for (const commentKey of queuedKeys) {
      await commentPublish.processPublicationNow({
        integrationId: integration.id,
        mergeRequestIid,
        commentKey,
      })
    }
  }

const commentPublishByKey = row
    ? await commentPublish.getCommentPublishByKeyForReview({
      integrationId: integration?.id ?? null,
      mergeRequestIid,
      findings: filteredFindings,
    })
    : {}

  return {
    review: row
      ? {
        id: row.id,
        summary: row.summary,
        findings: row.findings as AiReviewFinding[],
        personaMode: normalizeReviewPersonaMode(row.personaMode),
        persona: normalizeReviewPersona(row.persona),
        personaPasses: Array.isArray(row.personaPasses)
          ? row.personaPasses
              .map((entry) => String(entry ?? "").trim())
              .filter((entry) => entry.length > 0)
          : [],
        feedback: row.feedback,
        commentFeedbackByKey: {},
        commentPublishByKey,
        createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      }
      : null,
    suppressedFindingsCount: gateResult.suppressedFindingsCount,
    suppressedByReason: gateResult.suppressedByReason,
    gateProfile: {
      ...gatePreferences.effectiveSettings,
      personaMode,
      persona,
      personaPasses,
    },
    filteredFindings,
    summary,
    model,
    integrationId: integration?.id ?? null,
  }
}

  "gitlab_integrations",
  {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    instanceUrl: text("instance_url").notNull(),
    projectId: text("project_id").notNull(),
    projectPath: text("project_path").notNull(),
    projectName: text("project_name").notNull(),
    hookId: text("hook_id"),
    webhookUrl: text("webhook_url").notNull(),
    webhookSecretHash: text("webhook_secret_hash"),
    tokenCiphertext: text("token_ciphertext"),
    tokenIv: text("token_iv"),
    tokenAuthTag: text("token_auth_tag"),
    aiReviewAutoPostEnabled: boolean("ai_review_auto_post_enabled")
      .notNull()
      .default(false),
    status: gitlabIntegrationStatusEnum("status").notNull().default("degraded"),
    lastHookSyncAt: timestamp("last_hook_sync_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    lastWebhookReceivedAt: timestamp("last_webhook_received_at", {
      withTimezone: true,

    lastError: text("last_error"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [
    unique("gitlab_integrations_instance_project_uq").on(
      table.instanceUrl,
      table.projectId,

    index("gitlab_integrations_status_idx").on(table.status),
    index("gitlab_integrations_updated_at_idx").on(table.updatedAt),
  ],
);

  "gitlab_user_instance_tokens",

    userId: text("user_id")

    instanceUrl: text("instance_url").notNull(),
    tokenCiphertext: text("token_ciphertext").notNull(),
    tokenIv: text("token_iv").notNull(),
    tokenAuthTag: text("token_auth_tag").notNull(),
    staleAt: timestamp("stale_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    staleReason: text("stale_reason"),
    lastValidatedAt: timestamp("last_validated_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [
    unique("gitlab_user_instance_tokens_user_instance_uq").on(
      table.userId,
      table.instanceUrl,
    ),
    index("gitlab_user_instance_tokens_stale_at_idx").on(table.staleAt),
    index("gitlab_user_instance_tokens_updated_at_idx").on(table.updatedAt),
  ],
);

export const gitlabWebhookDeliveries = pgTable(
  "gitlab_webhook_deliveries",

      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),

export const indexConfigs = pgTable(
  "index_configs",
  {
    id: uuid("id").defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
    integrationId: uuid("integration_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => gitlabIntegrations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    configJson: jsonb("config_json").$type<JsonRecord>().notNull(),
    configHash: text("config_hash").notNull(),
    active: boolean("active").notNull().default(true),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [
    unique("index_configs_integration_config_hash_uq").on(
      table.integrationId,
      table.configHash,
    ),
    index("index_configs_integration_active_idx").on(
      table.integrationId,
      table.active,
    ),
  ],
);
